CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaIntro:
Hello… Lovely weather, isn't it? It's so pleasant…
…Oh, dear… I must have dozed off. Welcome.
My name is ERIKA. I am the LEADER of CELADON GYM.
I am a student of the art of flower arranging.
My POKéMON are solely of the GRASS type.
…Oh, I'm sorry, I had no idea that you wished to challenge me.
Very well, but I shall not lose.{PLAY_BGM MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaDefeat:
Oh! I concede defeat. You are remarkably strong.
I must confer on you the RAINBOWBADGE.
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaPostBattle:
You are cataloging POKéMON? I must say I'm impressed.
I would never collect POKéMON if they were unattractive.
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRainbowBadge:
The RAINBOWBADGE will make POKéMON up to Lv. 50 obey.
It also allows POKéMON to use STRENGTH in and out of battle.
Please also take this with you.
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM19:
TM19 contains GIGA DRAIN.
Half the damage it inflicts is drained to heal your POKéMON.
Wouldn't you agree that it's a wonderful move?
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ShouldMakeRoomForTh: You should make room for this.
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayIntro:
I should tell you about this GYM.
Only real ladies are allowed in here!
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayPostBattle: Bleaah! I hope ERIKA wipes you out!
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetIntro: Oh, welcome. I was getting bored.
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetPostBattle:
GRASS-type POKéMON are tough against the WATER type.
They also have an edge on ROCK- and GROUND-type POKéMON.
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaPostBattle: Oh, you were looking at ERIKA… You weren't looking at me…
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaIntro:
Look, look! See my POKéMON!
I like the GRASS type. I like how they're easy to raise.
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaPostBattle:
We only use GRASS-type POKéMON at our GYM.
Why? We also use them for making flower arrangements!
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaIntro:
Oh, hey!
We don't like BUG- or FIRE-type POKéMON in here!
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaPostBattle: Our LEADER ERIKA might be quiet, but she's famous around here.
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriIntro: Pleased to meet you. My hobby is POKéMON training.
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriPostBattle: I have a blind date coming up. I have to learn to be polite, especially if I have to battle.
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro:
Welcome to CELADON GYM!
You'd better not underestimate the nice ladies here.
CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle: I didn't bring my best POKéMON. Wait until next time!
